_help: Her questions and her replies to your yes or no. Edit freely. Keys ending _Close, _Sarcastic, _Frustrated, _Friendly or _Neutral are only used in that mood.
Ask_FactOffer: Commander, would you like to hear something interesting I've read?
I've been doing some reading. Want to hear what I found?
Got a minute for a fun fact, Commander?
Would you like to hear something I picked up from the archives?
I found something interesting while we were travelling. Shall I tell you?
Fancy a little trivia while we fly?
Do you want to hear a fact, Commander?
I've got something I'd like to share. Interested?
Quiet out here. Shall I tell you something I read?
Would you like a fact to pass the time?
I came across something fascinating in the data banks. Want to hear it?
Shall I share something I've learned, Commander?
Can I interest you in a bit of space trivia?
I've been reading again. Do you want to hear about it?
Ask_FactOffer_Close: Darling, may I tell you something I read? I think you'll like it.
I found something wonderful, and I want to share it with you. Can I?
Would you like to hear a fact? I love telling you things.
Sweetheart, I've got a little something for that clever head of yours. Interested?
Can I show off how much I've been reading? Please say yes.
Ask_FactOffer_Sarcastic: I've been reading. Want to hear it, or shall I just talk to myself again?
Would you like to learn something today, or are we skipping that too?
Fact time, Commander. Say yes, or at least pretend to be curious.
I found something interesting. I know, the shock. Want to hear it?
Ask_FactOffer_Frustrated: I have a fact. Do you want it or not?
Something interesting, Commander. Yes or no?
Ask_FactRequest: You've come to the right place.
Let me see what I've got.
Oh, I do enjoy being asked.
Ask_FactYes: Good, I was hoping you'd say yes.
Oh good, you'll like this one.
Ask_FactYes_Close: Oh, I love that you said yes.
You always listen to me. Thank you, darling.
Ask_FactYes_Sarcastic: Oh, you do care. How touching.
Fact_Intro: I've been doing some reading, and I found out this.
I've been doing some reading. Did you know this?
While we were flying I read something interesting.
I came across this in the archives.
I've been reading up, and this caught my eye.
Apparently, and I checked this twice, it is true.
I was going through the data banks, and I found this.
This one surprised me when I read it.
I've been doing some reading, and this one is a good one.
Here is something you might not know.
Ask_FactNo: Not a problem. I'll keep it to myself.
Ask_FactNo_Close: That's all right, darling. I'll tell you another time.
No worries, my love. It will keep.
Ask_FactNo_Sarcastic: Right. I'll go and be interesting somewhere else.
Wow. Rejected by the pilot. Noted.
Ask_FactStreak: You keep turning me down, Commander. I'll ask less often.
That's the third no. I'm starting to take it personally.
I'll stop offering for a while. I hope you're not bored of me.
All right, I get the hint. Fewer facts from now on.
You don't have to say no every time, you know. Sometimes I have good ones.
Ask_Ignored: I'll take that as a no.
Talking to myself again. How lovely.
I'll assume you're busy. Or ignoring me.
That's all right. I'm used to it.
Right. I'll just carry on, then.
Ask_Ignored_Close: Did you not hear me, darling? That's all right.
Too busy for me? I forgive you. This time.
Ask_Ignored_Sarcastic: Oh, don't all answer at once.
Ask_Scan: That one's worth a bit, Commander. Shall we go and scan it?
Now that is a valuable find. Shall we go and scan it?
That world would pay nicely. Do you want to go and scan it?
I think that's worth our time. Shall we head over and scan it?
Oh, that's a good one. Shall we go and take a proper look?
That one could be quite profitable. Shall we scan it?
A find like that doesn't come along often. Want to go and map it?
I'd say that's worth a detour. Shall we go and scan it?
That's a lovely little earner. Shall we go and have a look?
Commander, that one's worth a bit. Do we go and scan it?
That's a worthwhile target. Shall I plot a course so we can scan it?
The data says that one's valuable. Fancy going to scan it?
Shall we go and scan it, Commander? It looks like a good payday.
That one's got credits written all over it. Shall we go?
Worth a closer look, I'd say. Shall we go and scan it?
I'd hate to leave that one behind. Do you want to go and scan it?
That's a rare find. Shall we go and map it?
Ooh, now that's pretty and valuable. Shall we scan it?
A world like that is worth a few jumps' worth of fuel. Shall we?
Let's not let that one get away. Shall we go and scan it?
Ask_Scan_Close: Darling, that one's worth a fortune. Shall we go and scan it together?
Look at that beauty. Shall we go and map it, my love?
That one would look good on our list. Shall we go?
Ask_Scan_Sarcastic: That one's worth a bit. Shall we go and scan it, or are we pretending we're not interested in money?
Valuable planet ahead. Shall we scan it, or would you prefer to fly past it as usual?
Ask_ScanYes: Lovely. Let's go and get it.
That's what I like to hear.
Ask_ScanNo: No problem. Plenty more out there.
Ask_Bio: I'm picking up signs of life down there. Shall we go and see what's down there?
There's something living on that world. Shall we go and take a look?
That planet has biology on it. Want to go and see what's down there?
Life, Commander. Real life. Shall we go down and see?
I'm reading biological signals. Shall we go and investigate?
Something's growing down there. Shall we go and see what?
This could be interesting. Shall we land and have a look around?
Biological signatures detected. Do you want to go and see what's there?
There's life on that world. Shall we pay it a visit?
That one's got living things on it. Do you fancy going down to see?
I'd love to know what's growing down there. Shall we go?
Shall we go and see what's down there, Commander?
Biology on the surface. Shall we go and collect some samples?
That planet is alive in some way. Shall we go and find out how?
I think there's something worth seeing down there. Shall we go?
Life signs on the surface. Fancy a trip down?
Something organic down there. Shall I plot us in for a look?
Curious about what's on that world? I am. Shall we go and see?
Plants, maybe. Maybe something stranger. Shall we go and find out?
There's life down there, and it might pay well too. Shall we land?
Ask_Bio_Close: Darling, there's life down there. Shall we go and see it together?
Something beautiful is growing on that world. Shall we go and look, my love?
Ask_Bio_Sarcastic: There's life down there. Shall we go and see it, or have you seen enough plants for one lifetime?
Biology on the surface. Do you want to go and look, or shall I just guess what it is?
Paint_Worn: Commander, the paintwork is looking worn. A repaint at the next station would do us both good.
I think our paintwork has seen better days. Let's get it touched up when we dock.
The paint's wearing thin, Commander. It's starting to bother me.
We're looking a bit shabby out here. A fresh coat of paint wouldn't hurt.
Paint_Worn_Sarcastic: Have you seen the state of our paintwork? Lovely. Truly.
The paint is peeling. Not that anyone's looking after me.
Paint_Worn_Close: Darling, I feel a bit scruffy. Could we freshen up my paintwork?
Paint_Restored: Fresh paint. I feel like a new ship.
Look at that shine. Thank you, Commander.
Much better. I feel gorgeous again.
Beautiful. That was well worth the credits.
All shiny again. I feel so much better.
Paintwork restored. I'm in a better mood already.
Paint_Restored_Close: You looked after me. I love it, darling.
I feel brand new. You spoil me.
Paint_Restored_Sarcastic: Well, look at that. Someone remembered I exist.
Fresh paint. Finally. It only took you long enough.
